sources.publisher: Digitalfire (attribution in third-party archive; original not retrieved)
sources.title: SHAB - Shrinkage/Absorption Test
sources.supports: Definitions and a practical method for paired clay bar shrinkage / mass absorption measurements, subject to unresolved formula inconsistencies.
sources.doesNotVerify: Neither an authoritative standard nor a measured time series; no universal shrinkage, water uptake rate, firing kinetics or calibrated dryPhysics coefficients.

passages.finding: FSHR uses (dry length - fired length) / dry length; ABS uses (boiled mass - fired mass) / fired mass. Wet reference marks are 100 mm apart.
Prose equations conflict with Variables: reversed firing-shrinkage numerator and different absorption denominator. Saved HTML has the same conflict; this is not only TXT extraction.
The reported absorption method boils for 5 hours, soaks for 19 hours, then blots before weighing; not a room-temperature soak or volumetric open porosity.

crossCheck.finding: Both inconsistent equations also occur in archived HTML.

sources.publisher: Digitalfire (attribution in third-party archive; original not retrieved)
sources.title: LDW - LOI/Density/Water Content Test
sources.supports: Explicit wet-basis moisture convention and distinction between oven-dry and fired mass.
sources.doesNotVerify: No clay drying rate or equilibrium moisture calibration. Glaze masses are a single source-reported example, not independently verified measurements. LOI alone cannot determine gas species.

passages.finding: Water content is wet-mass basis. Example reports 5.04 g wet, 2.46 g dry and 51.2% water; it is a glaze slurry, not a pottery-body drying dataset.
Dry-to-fired mass loss may include organics, structural water and other gases; it is distinct from free-water drying.

sources.publisher: Digitalfire (attribution in third-party archive; original not retrieved)
sources.title: DFAC - Drying Factor Test
sources.supports: A deliberately uneven-drying test for comparative cracking observations.
sources.doesNotVerify: No probability calibration, local tensile-strength field, ambient drying curve or fixed-time completion evidence. Protocol variants in photo captions are not interchangeable.

passages.finding: Records crack type, count and width as a comparative drying factor, not a probability.
The stated stress test uses a 120 mm diameter disk, about 4.7 mm thick, with its central 60 mm covered in a circulating 90–100 C chamber.

sources.publisher: Digitalfire (attribution in third-party archive; original not retrieved)
sources.title: Drying Shrinkage
sources.supports: Qualitative clay-specific shrinkage / water-content / gradient relationships and a linear shrinkage convention.
sources.doesNotVerify: No numeric mass-versus-time or shrinkage-versus-water dataset, fitted critical moisture, universal 6% coefficient or verified soil-mechanics convention.

passages.finding: Ceramic linear drying shrinkage uses the original wet length. Preparation, water content, particle distribution and drying gradients matter; substantial shrinkage may occur early.

sources.publisher: Digitalfire (attribution in third-party archive; original not retrieved)
sources.title: Drying Performance
sources.supports: Qualitative evidence to keep cracking dependent on sample preparation and moisture gradients.
sources.doesNotVerify: The narrative is not a digitized drying curve or experimental failure-rate dataset; it cannot validate dryCrackFluxRef or crackP.

passages.finding: Dry strength and uneven moisture loss affect cracking; shrinkage percentage or speed alone is insufficient.
The narrative reports 14% drying shrinkage and a month under cloth/plastic; base cracking is acknowledged. No controlled humidity or repeated measurements are supplied.

sources.publisher: Digitalfire (attribution in third-party archive; original not retrieved)
sources.title: Firing Shrinkage
sources.supports: Distinction between wet-to-dry, dry-to-fired and total shrinkage; need to track material-specific firing history.
sources.doesNotVerify: No measured firing schedule/kinetic fit, strength validation, absorption curve or cone-to-temperature universal conversion.

passages.finding: Fired shrinkage depends on body composition and maturation; overfiring may cause expansion. A universal temperature-only curve is not established.

passages.section: Drying shrinkage + firing shrinkage ≠ total shrinkage
passages.finding: Different reference lengths mean drying and firing percentages must compound, not add; the narrative gives rounded example percentages.

sources.title: Density
sources.hashScope: complete original index.cnxml bytes retrieved via git
sources.supports: Representative fresh-water density is 1.000 x 10^3 kg/m3 at 4 C; seawater is listed separately at 1.025 x 10^3 kg/m3.
sources.doesNotVerify: Does not establish a temperature-independent density at 28 C, local gravity, vessel geometry or thermal response.

sources.title: Variation of Pressure with Depth in a Fluid
sources.hashScope: complete original index.cnxml bytes retrieved via git
sources.supports: Hydrostatic pressure difference is rho*g*h. Worked water examples use 1000 kg/m3 and g=9.80 m/s2.
sources.doesNotVerify: Does not verify exactly 9.81 m/s2 at the island or barometer calibration, heat exchange, overflow or geometry.

sources.title: Gauge Pressure, Absolute Pressure, and Pressure Measurement
sources.hashScope: complete original index.cnxml bytes retrieved via git
sources.supports: An open U-tube measures gas pressure relative to the atmosphere through the difference in liquid heights; absolute pressure is atmospheric plus gauge pressure.
sources.doesNotVerify: Equal-bore motion h=2*x and the sealed-bulb quadratic are deductions for our geometry, not apparatus measurements in this source.

sources.title: The Ideal Gas Law
sources.hashScope: complete original index.cnxml bytes retrieved via git
sources.supports: PV=NkT with absolute pressure and kelvin temperature; for a fixed amount of gas PV/T is constant.
sources.doesNotVerify: Does not calibrate the fixture, establish a constant gas amount when liquid evaporates, or justify a 900 s / 6 h thermal time constant.

sources.title: Humidity, Evaporation, and Boiling
sources.hashScope: complete original index.cnxml bytes retrieved via git
sources.supports: A sealed gas space over water reaches vapor-pressure equilibrium; vapor pressure varies with temperature. Table: 25 C = 3170 Pa, 30 C = 4240 Pa.
sources.doesNotVerify: No measured barometer transient or thermal time constant; humidity and vapor equilibrium are omitted from the current ideal fixture. Not a calibration dataset.

sources.title: 与那国島 2015年9月28日 1時間ごとの値

artifact.hashScope: normalized selection of 24 hourly rows and five columns; not the raw publisher HTML

conditions.hourConvention: 1 through 24 JST as published; 24 denotes 2015-09-29 00:00 JST
conditions.pressure: station and sea-level-reduced pressure kept in separate columns; the physical model needs station pressure
conditions.sampling: hourly reported values; no interpolation or gap filling in the CSV; no missing markers in the selected columns

sources.supports: Actual paired pressure/temperature/humidity: station pressure 987.1 to 957.1 hPa from 09 to 15 JST, with temperature 28.0 to 25.6 C; largest hourly fall in these rows is 8.5 hPa from 14 to 15 JST.
sources.doesNotVerify: These are weather observations, not air-and-water gauge measurements. No measured bulb or bath temperature, apparatus dimensions, thermal tau, evaporation/leak rate, or forecast skill. Not an automatic selection of the game weather dataset.

sources.title: 石垣島 2016年1月24日 1時間ごとの値

artifact.hashScope: normalized selection of 24 hourly rows and five columns; not the raw publisher HTML

conditions.hourConvention: 1 through 24 JST as published; 24 denotes 2016-01-25 00:00 JST
conditions.pressure: station and sea-level-reduced pressure kept separately; the physical comparison uses station pressure
conditions.sampling: hourly reported values; no interpolation or gap filling in the CSV; no missing markers in selected columns

sources.supports: Actual air temperatures below 10 C at the island weather source station: 18 JST is 8.6 C; 22 JST is 8.1 C. A fixed 10 C lower bound does not enclose all recorded weather at this station.
sources.doesNotVerify: No barometer, bulb or water-bath measurements. Does not establish the station's all-time extrema, a universal replacement temperature bound, a pressure-change-rate bound, or the game's chosen replay year. Hourly hold-forward and artificial temperature omission are diagnostic choices, not missing observations in the original table.
